## What is Scalemage?

Scalemage is an AI-powered image adaptation tool that transforms images between different advertising formats. Upload one image and instantly generate versions optimized for every major ad platform.

## Core Functionality

Image adaptation is the process of transforming an image from one aspect ratio to another while preserving visual quality, composition, and key elements. Unlike simple cropping or stretching, AI-powered adaptation intelligently recomposes the image for each target format.

## Supported Output Formats

- **Square (1080x1080, 1:1)**: Optimized for Instagram Feed, Facebook Feed, LinkedIn
- **Instagram Portrait (1080x1350, 4:5)**: Optimized for Instagram Feed (portrait), Facebook Feed
- **Portrait (1080x1920, 9:16)**: Optimized for Instagram Stories, TikTok, Facebook Stories, Reels
- **Horizontal (1920x1080, 16:9)**: Optimized for YouTube thumbnails, Display ads, Twitter/X

## How It Works

1. Upload your source image (any format)
2. Select one or more target output formats
3. Optionally add creative context to guide the AI adaptation
4. AI processes and adapts your image to each selected format
5. Download all adapted versions

## Key Features

- **AI-Powered Adaptation**: Uses advanced AI to intelligently recompose images
- **Multi-Format Generation**: Create multiple format versions from one upload
- **Creative Context Support**: Guide the AI with text descriptions for better results
- **Instant Processing**: Get results in seconds, not minutes
- **High Quality Output**: Full resolution outputs ready for advertising platforms

## Pricing

- 3 free credits on signup (no credit card required)
- $3 USD for 10 additional credits
- 1 credit = 1 image adaptation per format

## Use Cases

- Digital marketing teams adapting creatives for multi-platform campaigns
- Social media managers creating format-specific content
- Advertisers optimizing visuals for different ad placements
- E-commerce businesses adapting product images for various platforms

## Technical Details

- Accepts common image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
- Outputs high-quality images at exact platform specifications
- Web-based tool, works in any modern browser
- No software installation required
